change_record: Addendum v5.0 after owner decision D41 (post-launch patch wave: 00.00 percent allowance, explicit purchase/end/credit-day labels, tenure guard on every insert path, invalid-row render recovery, broker detail field), CONFIRMED in brainstorm v2.4.0: adds FR-62..FR-66 as TC-114..TC-128 with test_bindings covering the five new requirements (coverage 79/84 -> 84/84 on projection). Implemented in tests/test_tc87_d41_patch.py (15 tests) plus retargeted contracts in test_tc25_route_error.py and test_tc86_active_bonds.py (corrupt row: 500 -> 200 + Invalid chip per FR-65). All levels REMOTE per owner Q3 (GitHub Actions on push; no local test tier).

test_cases.title: Add Candidate accepts coupon and est-yield of 0.00 (zero-coupon bonds)
test_cases.steps: 1. POST /watch with coupon_pct=0.00, expected_yield_pct=0.00, valid 12-char ISIN. 2. Assert 302 and the row stores 0.0/0.0.
test_cases.expected: Entry accepted; zero percent values persist exactly.

test_cases.title: Zero percent variants 0 / 0.0 / 0.00 all accepted on both percent fields
test_cases.steps: 1. Repeat Add Candidate with each variant of 0 for coupon and est-yield. 2. Also submit 0.00 through Add Position percent fields.

test_cases.title: Percent field rejections stay named: empty, non-numeric, negative
test_cases.steps: 1. POST /watch with coupon_pct empty, then 'abc', then '-1.0'.
test_cases.expected: 400 with named errors ('is required', 'must be a number', 'must not be negative'); no row written.

test_cases.title: Move-to-Portfolio rejects a same-month range before any insert (tenure 0 guard)
test_cases.steps: 1. Seed a watching candidate. 2. POST /watch/<id>/move with start 2026-11-14 end 2026-11-30. 3. Re-read the bonds table.
test_cases.expected: 400 'tenure must span at least one whole month: 0'; row stays watch_state=watching with tenure_months NULL; bond count unchanged. Same guard applies to POST /add.

test_cases.title: A tenure-0 row in the database never 500s any surface (Invalid chip)
test_cases.steps: 1. Inject a holding row with tenure_months=0 directly. 2. GET /, /portfolio, /portfolio?tab=payouts, /print, /grid, both exports, /share.
test_cases.expected: All 200; the bad row renders status chip Invalid with 'dates need review' caption; derive_health itself unchanged (engine strict).

test_cases.title: Remove action deletes only invalid rows
test_cases.steps: 1. With the tenure-0 row present, click POST /portfolio/invalid/<id>/remove.
test_cases.expected: 302 back to holdings; row deleted; chip and caption gone.

test_cases.title: Remove action refuses a valid row (server-side revalidation)
Broker roundtrip: candidate -> move -> holdings drawer
test_cases.steps: 1. Add Candidate with broker='HDFC Securities'. 2. Move to Portfolio. 3. Read the detail drawer JSON.
test_cases.expected: broker persists end-to-end; detail JSON returns broker='HDFC Securities'.

test_cases.title: Add Position stores its own broker value
Move without broker keeps the candidate's broker
test_cases.steps: 1. Candidate carries broker='Kotak Securities'. 2. Move posting an empty broker.
test_cases.expected: Position keeps 'Kotak Securities' (CASE WHEN empty keeps candidate value).

test_cases.title: Explicit date labels present on both forms
test_cases.steps: 1. GET /watch and /portfolio. 2. Assert exact label strings.
test_cases.expected: Both forms show 'Purchase date (start date)', 'End date', 'Credit day — when the amount is credited each month'.

test_cases.title: Watchlist table has Broker column before Source note
test_cases.expected: Broker <th> appears immediately before Source note; row cells align.

test_cases.title: My Holdings table remains exactly nine columns
test_cases.expected: Exactly 9 columns; broker appears only in the drawer facts, not as a 10th column.

test_cases.title: Detail drawer JSON still returns for an invalid row
test_cases.expected: 200 JSON with broker field present; health fields marked invalid rather than raising.

test_cases.title: Corrupt-row error-page contracts retargeted to 200+Invalid (tc25/tc86)
test_cases.steps: 1. Run the retargeted test_tc25_route_error and test_tc86_active_bonds suites.
test_cases.expected: Dashboard corrupt-row paths assert 200 + Invalid chip (FR-65) instead of legacy 500; grid corrupt path per FR-65 scope; zero legacy 500 assertions remain on hardened surfaces.
